patch_description:
Use a small continuation portfolio rather than applying one sharpness schedule to every initializer.  The diameter-packing objective is nonsmooth and different basins can benefit from different rates of concentration onto active contacts.  This edit preserves the successful quadratic 6-to-100 path, adds a slower 6-to-200 schedule, and adds a piecewise schedule that explores with moderate sharpness before focusing strongly on the final contact graph.

The refinement also records the best exact ratio encountered during its trajectory.  At high sharpness, a smooth surrogate may occasionally make a final step that improves its surrogate but slightly worsens the true bottleneck ratio; returning the exact incumbent prevents that loss.  All schedules and seeds remain deterministic.
